messages:
maria: Quick sync - security needs a timeboxed SIEM snapshot for vuln triage (CVE-2026-0421). Asking for 90-day retention on the exported file, and a tiny RBAC grant for 3 people. Who picks this up?
jen: Open SEC-2030 with justification, datasets, exact user list, scrub rules, bucket name, and timeline. I'll triage the ticket.
evan: We should avoid raw plaintext keys. Use export-proxy + KMS CMK with Unwrap audit enabled. Also require ephemeral role with MFA.
sam: Can triage work with redacted data? Mask emails, hash IPs, remove auth tokens. If so it lowers legal friction.
maria: Fields needed: @timestamp, service, host, request_id, log, exception. PII scrub rules: email=><redacted>, ip=>sha256(ip). Scope limited to prod-auth and prod-frontend, window 2026-03-10..2026-03-17.
lee: SRE: we can set exporter limits (concurrent=1, throttle=12MB/s) and gzip output. We'll provision a short-lived role siem:ephemeral (12h max).
sam: S3 lifecycle: auto-delete after 90 days, fallback 14 days if legal declines. Limit export size to 200MB.
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-2030 assigned to @jen and @lee - https://redwood.internal/insights/SEC-2030
jen: Add rollback steps, exact KQL used, reviewer list, and the script to verify KMS unwrap logs. Once updated I'll escalate to SRB.
